profile.headline: Autonomous Driving

positions.title: Information Technology Assistant
positions.description: •	Updated compute infrastructure to Ubuntu 18.04 while maintaining functionality of tools and pipelines for medical image processing and machine learning, transitioning all 12 workstations to LTS and establishing 2 new compute server nodes.

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
•	Conducted instruction through office hours, labs, discussion sessions, online assistance, and grading feedback, allowing students to access and grasp CS 107/107E Computer Systems material easily and efficiently: C, ASM (ARM/x86), systems, sensors, graphics, coding style, etc.
•	Managed student repositories to deploy, review, and autograde assignments using Github and Python.

positions.title: Autonomous Driving Software Intern
positions.description:
• Developed solutions to further optimize trajectory prediction neural network for FP16 and INT8 inference on Drive AGX platform, resulting in over 2.0x speedup over previously optimized models.
• Implemented workflow to reduce quantization error in INT8 models through quantization-aware training in PyTorch and per tensor calibration in TensorRT (C++).

positions.title: GPU Board Operations Software Intern
positions.description:
•	Created deep learning workflow from scratch for screening GPUs by capturing frames from traces with DirectX, training networks, and setting performance metrics and benchmarks (Python and C++).
•	Developed deep learning solutions on Keras + Tensorflow for supervised and unsupervised anomaly detection in high-resolution frames, validating GPUs on non-deterministic apps with >90% accuracy.

positions.title: Embedded Storage Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed system for automated simulation and analysis of NAND storage firmware in Python and C, upgrading the infrastructure to effectively evaluate the performance impact of software changes.
•	Programmed infrastructure to filter real user workloads, build controlled test environments, and analyze performance data, enhancing the development process of tuning algorithms and parameters.

positions.title: Hybrid Powertrain Development & Controls Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
•	Investigated driving patterns of 2.9k real-world vehicles (65k total trips) to produce an official Toyota technical report, which modeled customer driving habits and assisted group’s hybrid platform design and development.
•	Implemented an informative calculator for plug-in hybrid fuel economy to train team members, establishing group understanding of EPA and CAFE regulations to study plug-in hybrid design and benefits. 
•	Simulated, analyzed, and reported competitor hybrid systems for performance, drivability, and efficiency, guiding development items by expanding collection of benchmark results and automated analysis tools.

positions.title: Brake & Active Safety Platform Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and assembled touchscreen interface on vehicle CAN bus to refine system control and measurement display, enhancing overall user experience of prototype systems in demonstration vehicles.
•	Created a new brake pedal kinematic simulation tool to model assembly motion and master cylinder rod deflection, improving group ability to evaluate assembly packaging and hardware durability.
•	Organized and performed vehicle benchmark test to analyze characteristics of an undocumented competitor brake system, generating template for future benchmarking and data for new system development.

positions.title: Systems Validation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted wiper system validation lab, ensuring quality in design and production of system programs.
•	Executed durability, thermal, and load tests that followed official and customer specifications for wiper systems.
•	Collaborated with engineers and constructed testing plans, structures, and harnesses to meet testing criteria.
•	Reported systems’ performance data and communicated with engineers and program managers about results.

educations.schoolName: University of Michigan College of Engineering

honors.title: James B. Angell Scholar
honors.description:
Currently, achieved "A" record for 5 consecutive terms.

Students who achieve an “A” record (all grades of A+, A, or A-) for two or more consecutive terms are recognized as James B. Angell Scholars. 

Angell Scholars with three, four, five, or six consecutive terms are seated together as a group in a reserved section of the auditorium. During the convocation, they will be escorted on stage where they will be congratulated by the president and provost.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Michigan · Dec 2016

honors.title: Delphi Industry Scholarship
honors.description: This scholarship was awarded by merit judged by the The Delphi Foundation,  which was established in 1999 as an independent, non-profit organization for the purpose of strategically contributing funds to worthy causes with a focus on education, primarily in the areas of science, technology, engineering and math (STEM).

organizations.name: College of Engineering Honors Program
organizations.description:
The College of Engineering Honors Program was established in 2012 for high-achieving engineering students committed to developing technical excellence and leveraging the broad educational experiences available at the University of Michigan.

Our role is to demonstrate:
-Extraordinary academic ability
-Intellectual curiosity
-A clear potential to make a difference as a leader in their field

organizations.name: Michigan Formula Hybrid Racing
organizations.description:
•	Led development and integration of electric vehicle (EV) controls and communication with dSPACE microcontroller using Simulink, ranking 3rd for design and 5th overall at 2016 Formula Hybrid competition.
•	Directed entire development of new motor controller driver on MATLAB/Simulink for dSpace MicroAutoBox using RS232 serial bus, providing a simple interface to implement advanced motor controls.
•	Established simulations to test controls of high voltage circuits, motor communication, and battery management system, which improved design process and fulfilled performance requirements before deadlines.
•	Researched and applied simulation of hybrid energy management strategy to study formula hybrid racecar, building team tools and knowledge on hybrid powertrain and regenerative braking controls.
•	Acquired new company sponsors to support controls projects, generating $21,500 in essential material.
